title: Cosmic Sailor of Elements
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large central astronaut with a green bearded face covered in popcorn, floating above a calm sea with a red-sailed ship. To the left a giant smiling green moon and a blue dripping creature with yellow eyes appear, while the right side erupts in chaotic orange fire and smoke against a mountainous backdrop under a crescent moon.
